nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and refinance-ready — the play is to move fast and remove friction, not re-sell. With a $74,359 balance, $457/mo P&I, and $38/mo PMI, the next step is a soft pull to surface a real rate and confirm whether PMI drops off, not another round of questions.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly to what they asked — skip the generic intro
  - Reference their actual situation: 4.5% conventional, $457/mo P&I, plus $38/mo PMI on top
  - Do not open with discovery questions or re-pitch the idea of refinancing

- Surface the concrete opportunity in one or two lines
  - Their all-in payment today is $457 P&I + $38 PMI = $495/mo
  - With a $74,359 remaining balance, even a modest rate improvement moves the needle — and a refi may eliminate PMI entirely depending on current appraised value
  - Do NOT invent a new rate or savings figure; let the soft pull produce the real number

- Drive straight to the frictionless next step
  - Offer the soft credit pull right now: 'It won't affect your score and I can show you an actual rate in minutes'
  - Send the e-sign link or application URL in the same message — one tap, no phone tag required
  - Give a specific, low-friction call to action: 'Click the link, takes about 3 minutes, and I'll have real numbers back to you today'
